notes.title: About the game controls
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
I saw some people not satisfied with the control of the game, but the game level is designed like this: for the first level goes up  by collecting air bubbles while moving left and right, and the larvae will sink when the bubbles disappear!

Support this game please, thank you very much!

notes.title: Update Notice(170916)
notes.content:
1. Fixed a bug about the arrow at the level 4.
2. Added a tip at the beginning of the game to tell players how to control.

This game is unique, I want to combine art and game play, and keep it as simple as possible so that I can focus on the most important part.
If you have any suggestions please tell me. 
Wish you a good day,
Thank you so much!
